headline: Nevish Line Rekindles as Expanse Fight Slackens
war_summary: The latest wires turn the tables since the past edition, with the Nevish Line back to the fore at six changes in two hours and seventy-four in the day about Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal, now standing five Warden and three Colonial after 6,197 Colonial and 7,147 Warden casualties in the day, while the Weathered Expanse cools to three changes in two hours and fifty-one in the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, holding six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral after 6,328 and 6,087 casualties. Marban Hollow stirs at the hour with two fresh changes and seventeen in the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now three aside and two neutral, and Linn Mercy rests without a turn in two hours after five in six and sixteen in the day about Lathair, holding one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral. Kuura Strand shows no turn in six hours after nineteen in the day about Faden Point and Talven, and Stlican Shelf records two late changes about Briar, though Callahan's Passage spends 4,215 and 2,366 casualties without a recorded flip.
